definitions.Monte_Carlo_intervals: Pointwise normal95% world-level intervals conditional on frozen assumptions; no empirical market confidence or multiple-comparison correction
definitions.spendable_cash_above_initial_seed: max(0,reported available_cash-initial seed); cash above original seed before an additional operating planning floor, not profit or fully unreserved investment funds
definitions.throughput: Useful outcomes divided by fixed104selling weeks or full120week horizon; not annualized observed production or claimed steady-state capacity
definitions.useful_collections_only_surplus: Collections joined to useful outcomes minus ALL accrued enterprise expenses and all unexpensed closing obligations; all costs of false passes, failures and refunds remain
definitions.useful_outcome: Simulated delivered, on-time, truly correct outcome; latent model truth, not empirical provider or customer quality validation

reporting_priority: Commercial Beta profitability is primary; optional retained Alpha is a secondary incremental decision

capacity_and_capital.minimum_required_seed: Not identified; minimum path cash and peak draw are outcomes, not counterfactual seed requirements

pooled_ratios.basis: Sums over all64worlds divided by outcome counts; descriptive derived ratios, not matched-job margins or prices

completed_job_quotes.basis: All completed-job outcomes in the 64 Beta worlds; quotes were offered for jobs, not necessarily collected

representative_order_events.basis: Directly recorded order events in the first prespecified Beta sample only

limitations: Observed professional-service rates with assumed team hours, not observed matched project quotations or verified human-only effort.
Frontier model task quality, fully automated acceptance, demand and buyer trust are scenario assumptions without empirical quality-floor validation.
Prices were selected on the network policy family and tested on Beta, not independently optimized for Beta.
The useful-receipt filter is a reporting sensitivity over retained outcomes, not a new scientific freeze or live customer measurement.
Pooled ratios mix scopes, failures and common costs; they are not matched job margins.
